reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with the QR on the box; I'd scan it before paying, and if the report is a real batch with a named lab I'd try one box of the plain bisglycinate, since the sachets are easy to throw in a bag when I travel. Two capsules is a bit annoying, but I'd rather have the proof than a bigger label claim.
objection: Capsule size: two size 00 capsules a day is a lot to swallow, and I'm not convinced the QR report is more than marketing until I actually open it.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR batch report didn't open to a real, readable lab result with a named lab, I wouldn't buy.
